# Required queries and string handling cannot be accepted as known failures.
# The 8-bit forms of APC, PM and SOS are not among them: term reads its
# input as UTF-8, in which bytes 0x80 to 0x9f are not C1 controls, and
# upstream passes them in xterm only with UTF-8 off (disableWideChars).

DECRQMTests.test_DECRQM_DEC_DECOM
PMTests.test_PM_Basic

SOSTests.test_SOS_Basic
SaveRestoreCursorTests.
# Keyboard protocols, Unicode, sync, focus, OSC 10/11 and OSC 52 have their
# own host tests with no exceptions. Other DECRQM cases test DEC modes the
# library does not claim to implement.
